description: This file defines the SugarJobQueue class, which manages job queue operations such as submitting, retrieving, resolving, postponing, deleting, and cleaning up jobs in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It interacts with the database and other beans to handle scheduled jobs.

classes.name: SugarJobQueue
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the job queue, including submitting, fetching, resolving, postponing, deleting, and cleaning job records in the database, with configurable parameters for retries and timeouts.

methods.name: submitJob
methods.description: Adds a new job to the queue with default status and resolution, generating a GUID if needed.

methods.name: getJob
methods.description: Retrieves a job bean by its ID from the database.

methods.name: resolveJob
methods.description: Marks a job as success or failure with optional message.

methods.name: postponeJob
methods.description: Reschedules a job to run later, optionally with a message and delay.

methods.name: deleteJob
methods.description: Deletes a job record from the database.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Forcefully resolves jobs that have exceeded the timeout period as failed.

methods.name: clearHistoricJobs
methods.description: Removes old successfully completed and failed jobs based on retention policies.

methods.name: cleanQueue
methods.description: Deletes all jobs from the queue.

methods.name: nextJob
methods.description: Fetches the next queued job, marks it as running, and assigns it to a client.

methods.name: runSchedulers
methods.description: Initiates scheduled job checking and execution.
